content: Kiŋkoŋɛ ki mwɛɛ mu yi nshɛŋ le chɛŋe bɛ mu Nyo
Fiɛɛ fì jade fi too bɛ waa mo bvuju a bɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ le la? Gɛ nyume kiŋkoŋɛ ki mwɛɛ mù ye yene goone mù bɛɛne shɛ́ŋ yene le gɛ?

Bɛŋ doo bɛŋ goone fiɛɛ njɛ bɛŋ kɛmɛ sɛŋ, bɛŋ tu bɛŋ goone ki bɛŋ yûuyɛ muh fɛ bɛŋ kɛ̂mɛ. Nɛ bɛŋ doo bɛŋ bvushi ajii yi fiɛɛ le fi fuge, bɛŋ tu bɛŋ waade, bɛŋ juu. Fiɛɛ fì gee lɛ keefɛ bɛŋ kɛ̂me mwɛɛ munɛ gɛ le nje bɛŋ baaŋ lɛgɛ gɛ fɛ Nyo le gɛ.
Nɛ bɛŋ doo bɛŋ lɛgɛ, bɛŋ gɛ kɛmɛ gɛ, nje gɛ bɛŋ lɛge bɛ baŋkwajɛ ba kooji gɛ. Bɛŋ lɛge mwɛɛ nyume gɛh ki bɛŋ gêe mwɛɛ mù ye yene goone le yu.

Bɛŋ le lo njɛ bikɛse kɛnɛ bilɛŋsɛ bò le bo chinɛ wa yéh yiboo le bo tu bo gime bɛ bikɛɛ bamii bamu kɛnɛ bilɛɛŋ bamii bamu. Gɛ bɛŋ kee lɛ muh kole nsaŋ bɛ woŋ kfunɛ, tu wu le wu tu wa muh wu kimbanɛ fɛ Nyo le gɛ? Noo, bɛŋ kêe lɛ no nyume yɛɛŋ wù le wu cha fie ki wu kôo nsaŋ bɛ woŋ kfunɛ, tu mwɛdɛ le wu tu wa muh wu kimbanɛ bɛ Nyo.
Taŋlo bɛŋ jiɛnyɛ nɛɛ fɛ bɛŋ kwâji lɛ fiɛɛ fì ba gɛ̀ saŋ a Ŋwa wu Nyo le, le achiji? Ba gɛ̀ saŋ lɛ, “Nyo kɛme kiŋkoŋɛ, wu beede baaŋ fɛ kiyo ki wu gɛ̀ gɛlɛ lɛ ki nyûme ye yese besabɛŋ le.”
Nyo nyaa nfih besabɛŋ le baaŋ. Le fiɛɛ fì ba saŋ a Ŋwa wu Nyo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nyo shiishi bamii ba chiaase ye yiboo,
geenɛ wu nya nfih bamii ba shiishi bikwɛɛ biboo le.”

content: Noo, bɛŋ nyâ bikwɛɛ biɛna Nyo le, bɛŋ lɛ̂ɛŋ bɛŋ sô bikaa debele le wu fɛ̂ɛ lo a bɛŋ jiŋ.
Bɛŋ tô mbebe yi Nyo le, wu tô tɛ mbebe yene le. Bɛŋ bamii ba befe bɛŋ bvûushɛ chiaaŋ fɛ mwɛɛ mù mbefe le, bɛŋ chûgɛ muntele mwɛna bɛŋ ba lɛme bɛ muntele munfɛɛ bɛ Nyo.
Bɛŋ nyûme bɛ yii, bɛŋ bêede bɛŋ shîishi ajoo nɛ wowowo. Bɛŋ lû bɛ chike, bɛŋ bêede gɛh nyume kwe, bɛŋ lû bɛ njoŋ wù bɛŋ yuge, bɛŋ sôge nyume bikwɛɛ.
Bɛŋ shîishɛ bikwɛɛ biɛna a Nyo jii, wu bɛ̂ɛŋsɛ bɛŋ.
Keefɛ muh sâge gee chi mwa bwee gɛ

Booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ, keefɛ muh jɛ̂me jɛ́ yì befe kune mwa bwee gɛ. Nɛ muh jɛme jɛ́ yì befe kune mwa bwee kɛnɛ wu sage gee chi mwa bwee, tu wu jɛme jɛ́ yì befe nyu kune nchi wu Nyo wu ka sage nchi wuyu. Nɛ muh sage nchi wu Nyo, tu gɛ wu baaŋ muh wù gɛɛde nchi wɛɛ gɛ. Wɛɛ muh le wu tu wa muh wù sage lo nchi.
Muh wù nyaa nchi wu ka suune bansa ba bamii, le gɛh wu mumwaa. Le gɛh wu wù taŋlo wu bvûsɛ kɛnɛ wu lɛ̂ɛshɛ muh. Wo le yɛɛŋ wù sage gee chi muh mu?
Keefɛ bɛŋ chîaase ye gɛ
Bɛŋ yêgɛ bɛŋ yû, bɛŋ ba jade bɛŋ duu lɛ, “Abɛŋ kɛnɛ fɛwɛge bee lé be gɛ̂ɛŋ kilaantɛŋ kinɛ le, kɛnɛ kege le, be chê yo yi kiluŋ le, bee kâmɛ waaŋ, bee kɛ̂mɛ mbe.”
Bɛŋ doo bɛŋ jɛme noo, bɛŋ kee fiɛɛ fì lé fi bû fi kôoshɛ fɛwɛge? Bɛŋ kee fiɛɛ fì le kinche kena? Kinche kena le njɛ kimbɛ kì ba yɛne ki le, ki lɛɛŋ shige ki mo ki lɛ̂sɛ.
Fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ bee bɛŋ jɛ̂mɛ le lɛ, “Nɛ Tada fɛnɛ le wu bɛɛŋ lɛ bee nyûme yu, bee gê finɛ kɛnɛ fiege.”
Geenɛ, bɛŋ jade fiena bɛŋ ka bɛŋ chiaase lo ye, bɛŋ kfuunɛ gvuu. Bɛŋ kêe lɛ kinchiaase ye noo le kimbefɛ.
Noo, muh wù kee fiɛɛ fì kooji fi wù kɛme ki wu gê, njɛ wu ge sɛŋ, tu wu le wu ge kimbefɛ.

footnotes.text: Kɛnɛ lɛ, “Kiyo ki Yuude kì Nyo gɛ̀ nya besabɛŋ le, ki kɛme kiŋkoŋɛ, ki beede baaŋ lɛ besabɛŋ lɛ̂me gɛh nyu bɛ Nyo.”
Nchi wunɛ taŋlo nyûme wɛɛ wù jɛme lɛ, “Wo kôŋe muh wù le mbebe yo le no wo koŋe kikwɛɛ kuŋ.”
